title: FightSafe AI — EAAI reproducibility artefact: availability-aware interpretable temporal event pipeline (BoxingVI case study)
description: Canonical FightSafe AI v1.0.0 research artefact for the EAAI manuscript “Engineering an Interpretable Temporal Event Pipeline with Explicit Channel Availability: A Combat-Sports Case Study”. The GitHub repository itself is the official software package: frozen canonical results (run_20260730_005150), configs, aggregation schemes with explicit availability masking, Tier A regeneration scripts, environment freeze and checksums. The LaTeX manuscript is maintained separately (sibling paper1 workspace). Not a safety-certified system; not a state-of-the-art detector claim; not a medical device. Synthetic missingness only. Restricted video, skeleton keypoints and features_cache are not redistributed.
